## REVENUE MODEL BREAKDOWN

### Path 1: Freelance Services (FASTEST — $50-200/hour)

| Service | Price | Time to Deliver | Effective $/Hour |
|---------|-------|-----------------|------------------|
| Simple website clone | $99 | 1-2 hours | $50-99 |
| Full website clone (10 pages) | $199 | 3-4 hours | $50-66 |
| Landing page | $49 | 1 hour | $49 |
| Custom AI tool (simple) | $199 | 2-3 hours | $66-100 |
| Custom AI tool (medium) | $499 | 6-10 hours | $50-83 |

**How to get clients:**
1. **Fiverr** — List 3 gigs (see FREELANCE_GIGS.md)
2. **Upwork** — Send 10 proposals/day
3. **Twitter/X** — Post portfolio, before/after screenshots
4. **Reddit** — r/forhire, r/webdev, r/freelance
5. **Cold Email** — Businesses with outdated websites

### Path 2: Passive Income (SLOWER — $5-50/day per site)

| Revenue Source | Monthly Estimate | Requirements |
|----------------|------------------|--------------|
| Google AdSense | $100-500/month | 10,000+ monthly visitors |
| Affiliate links | $50-200/month | Relevant product links |
| Premium prompts | $100-1000/month | Email list + traffic |

**How to scale:**
1. Build 5-10 niche tool sites
2. SEO optimize each site
3. Cross-promote between sites
4. Build email list for premium offers

### Path 3: Hybrid (RECOMMENDED — $50-150/hour)

Combine freelance services with passive income:
- Use freelance work to fund ad spend
- Use portfolio sites as proof of capability
- Reinvest profits into more sites
- Build recurring revenue through maintenance packages
